content: गुप्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [गुप् कर्मणि क्त] .²1 Protected, preserved, guarded; गुप्तं ददृशुरात्मानं सर्वाः स्वप्नेषु वामनैः <ls>R. 10. 60</ls>. .²2 Hidden, concealed, kept secret; <ls>Ms. 2. 160</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">7. 76</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">8. 374</ls>. .²3 Secret, private. .²4 Invisible, withdrawn from sight. .²5 Joined. .{@-प्तः@} .²1 An appellation usually (though not necessarily) added to the name of a Vaiśya; as चन्द्रगुप्तः, समुद्रगुप्तः <ab>&c.</ab> (Usually शर्मन् or देव is added to the name of a Brāhmaṇa; गुप्त, भूति or दत्त to that of a Vaiśya; and दास to that of a Śūdra; <ab>cf.</ab> शर्मा देवश्च विप्रस्य वर्मा त्राता च भूभुजः . भूतिर्दत्तश्च वैश्यस्य दासः शूद्रस्य कारयेत्). .²2 An epithet of Viṣṇu. .{@-प्तम्@} {%ind.%} Secretly, privately, apart. .{@-प्ता@} One of the principal female characters in a poetical composition, a lady married to another (परकीया) who conceals her loverʼs caresses and endearments past, present or future; वृत्तसुरतगोपना, वर्तिष्यमाणसुरतगोपना and वर्तमानसुरतगोपना; see <ls>Ras. M. 24</ls>.
